# GoCoding

> > GoCoding offers comprehensive coding, robotics, game development, and STEM education classes for kids ages 4-15 across multiple locations with both in-person and online options.

GoCoding is a youth education platform providing hands-on programming and robotics instruction through age-based learning structures. With locations in Brooklyn, New Jersey, Minnesota, and Dubai, plus online classes, GoCoding combines technical skills training with creative projects like game development, video blogging, and AI literacy.

## Key Topics

- Kids Coding Classes

## Class Locations & Enrollment

- [GoCoding Brooklyn](https://gocoding.tech): Main GoCoding location: coding classes for kids 4-15 in Brooklyn, NY
- [GoCoding New Jersey](https://newjersey.gocoding.tech): New Jersey location: coding, robotics, math for kids 4-15
- [GoCoding Twin Cities](https://mn.gocoding.tech): Minnesota location: coding, robotics, math for kids 4-15
- [Online Coding Classes](https://online.gocoding.tech): Live online coding, robotics, game dev classes for kids 4-15
- [Trial Classes](https://trial.gocoding.tech): Free trial classes in programming, design, and digital literacy for ages 5-15
- [Contact Us](https://gocoding.tech/contacts): Contact information and office locations in Brooklyn, Jersey City, Dubai
